text:
Issue: Lumo smart plug overheated, smelled like burning, and left a black mark on socket.
Status: Unplugged; escalated to product safety for same-day contact, replacement, and unit collection.
Next step: Product safety team to contact customer urgently and arrange inspection/replacement.
